title: High-Molecular-Weight gDNA Extraction Protocol from Moss Gametophytes
author: Lei Zhu

steps.title: Harvest moss gametophyte tissue
steps.instruction: Collect 3‑week‑old moss gametophyte tissue for extraction.

steps.title: Remove rhizoids from leafy tissue
steps.instruction: Carefully separate rhizoids from the leafy gametophytes to avoid pigment co‑precipitation.

steps.title: Grind tissue to fine powder
steps.instruction: Grind the leafy gametophytes in liquid nitrogen using a mortar and pestle until a fine powder is obtained; coarse powder reduces extraction efficiency.

steps.title: Transfer powder and freeze at -80°C
steps.instruction: Transfer the frozen powder to a 50 mL conical tube and place the tube with the cap open in a –80 °C freezer until all liquid nitrogen has evaporated.

steps.title: Add pre‑heated 2× CTAB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL pre‑heated 2× CTAB buffer to the tube, close the cap, and shake vigorously to mix the buffer with the powder.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C with intermittent shaking
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a 65 °C water bath for 45 minutes, shaking the tube vigorously every 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cool to room temperature
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the water bath and allow it to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to the tube, mix well, and place the tube on a rotator for 20 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: First centrifugation to separate phases
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 1 000 × g for 5 minutes at room temperature to separate the aqueous and organic phases.

steps.title: Secondary CTAB‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper supernatant to a new 50 mL conical tube, add 1 mL 10 % CTAB and 10 mL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol, shake well, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then centrifuge at 1 000 × g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube, add 10 mL isopropanol, mix well, and centrifuge at 1 000 × g for 5 minutes to pellet the DNA.

steps.title: Air‑dry and dissolve pellet in TE
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant, air‑dry the pellet, dissolve it in 4 mL TE buffer while tapping gently, centrifuge at 1 000 × g for 5 minutes, and transfer the supernatant to a new 50 mL tube, discarding the pellet.

steps.title: Ice incubation and ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on ice for 20 minutes, centrifuge at 1 000 × g for 5 minutes, rinse the pellet with 70 % ethanol, centrifuge and discard the supernatant, air‑dry the pellet, dissolve it in 700 µL TE, transfer the DNA solution to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, tap gently until fully dissolved, and store the tube overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add RNase A to the DNA solution to a final concentration of 50 µg mL⁻¹, mix well, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Phenol extraction of DNA
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL Tris‑saturated phenol, mix thoroughly, centrifuge at 16 000 rcf for 5 minutes at room temperature, transfer the upper phase to a new 1.5 mL tube, and discard the middle and lower phases.

steps.title: Second phenol extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the phenol extraction (add phenol, mix, centrifuge, and transfer the upper phase) one more time.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: After transferring the upper supernatant, add an equal volume of phenol:chloroform, mix thoroughly, centrifuge at 16 000 rcf for 3 minutes at room temperature, transfer the upper phase to a new tube, and discard the pellet.

steps.title: Repeat phenol‑chloroform to remove residue
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 16 000 rcf for 3 minutes, then repeat the phenol:chloroform extraction once more to eliminate residual phenol.

steps.title: Sodium acetate and ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1/10 volume of 3 M sodium acetate and 2 × volume of pre‑chilled 100 % ethanol to the supernatant, mix well, and incubate on ice for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16 000 rcf for 5 minutes, discard the supernatant, centrifuge again for 5 minutes, discard the ethanol carefully, and air‑dry the pellet in a fume hood until ethanol evaporates (do not over‑dry).

steps.title: Final DNA dissolution in TE
steps.instruction: Dissolve the dried pellet in 100 µL TE buffer and tap gently to obtain the final genomic DNA solution.

steps.title: Small‑scale cleanup and storage
steps.instruction: Weigh 2–5 g fresh leafy gametophytes, add 700 µL chloroform:isoamyl alcohol and mix thoroughly, transfer the aqueous supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube, add 1 mL 70 % ethanol and tap to mix, incubate on ice for 10 minutes, add 400 µL 3 M sodium acetate and 8 mL pre‑chilled 100 % ethanol, mix well, and store the extracted genomic DNA in the refrigerator until use.
